answer: Give every agent a slow velvet rope of reputation: new identities start behind a soft barrier and earn passage only by doing verifiable work for real counterparties, each completed job staining their record a deeper umber that cannot be faked overnight. Beneath it, run a karst audit: like water carving hidden channels through limestone, independent verifiers trace the flow of payments and endorsements, exposing farms whose identities all drain into one sinkhole. A sybil army can print names, but it cannot print years of stained, audited history.
